bugfix: Fix checkout calculations across catalog.py, pricing.py and tax.py. discount and tax_rate are fractional rates (0.10 means 10%). Apply discount before tax, round final monetary result to two decimal places. Reject discount outside [0,1], negative tax_rate, and negative item price or quantity with ValueError. Preserve checkout(lines, discount, tax_rate).
feature: Implement atomic stock-aware purchases across store.py, inventory.py and orders.py. Store.purchase(items) accepts a dict of SKU to positive integer quantity. On success return {"accepted": True} and decrement stock. If any SKU has insufficient stock, return {"accepted": False, "reason": "insufficient_stock"} and do not change any stock. Zero, negative or noninteger quantities raise ValueError without changing stock. Preserve Inventory.available(sku).
